knowledge.name: Frozen synthetic client portfolio
knowledge.detail: Bundled records cover eight fictional clients, values, NPS, margins, utilization, billing, escalations, and health labels.

knowledge.name: Retention rules and stakeholder evidence
knowledge.detail: Packaged rules define churn indicators, recovery actions, account owners, executive sponsors, delivery leads, and engagement plans.

knowledge.name: Governed operating instructions
knowledge.detail: Instructions require synthetic-only grounding, uncertainty labels, account-team review, approval gates, and no external side effects.

intelligence_processing.name: Portfolio health segmentation
intelligence_processing.detail: Ranks fixed client records as critical, at risk, or healthy and summarizes portfolio value, exposure, and average health.

intelligence_processing.name: Engagement signal analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Connects executive-contact cadence, escalations, billing direction, and utilization to highlight weakening relationships.

intelligence_processing.name: Satisfaction trend review
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares four quarterly satisfaction scores and NPS to identify improving, stable, or declining synthetic relationships.

intelligence_processing.name: At-risk intervention prioritization
intelligence_processing.detail: Explains risk drivers and deterministic first recovery actions while treating churn probabilities as scenario indicators only.

intelligence_processing.name: Stakeholder-led retention planning
intelligence_processing.detail: Builds account-specific stakeholder maps, preparation steps, engagement proposals, and account-owner approval gates.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio conversational experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Client-success, account-management, and experience personas invoke five validated behaviors through a Draft conversational agent.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: The single-file RAPP agent runs through local Brainstem chat and API endpoints with bundled synthetic evidence only.

clients_user_interface.name: Account-team review experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Responses separate evidence, indicators, and proposed actions so the internal account team can review before any outreach.

management_reporting.name: Client Health Dashboard
management_reporting.detail: Reports portfolio value, at-risk value, average health, health distribution, churn indicators, NPS, margin, and utilization.

management_reporting.name: Engagement and satisfaction review
management_reporting.detail: Shows executive meetings, escalations, billing trends, utilization, quarterly satisfaction movement, and NPS evidence.

management_reporting.name: At-Risk Client Report
management_reporting.detail: Summarizes affected accounts, value at risk, health, indicators, satisfaction, escalation history, and proposed recovery actions.

management_reporting.name: Account Retention Playbooks
management_reporting.detail: Presents sponsors, account owners, delivery leads, preparation steps, next engagements, and explicit approval gates.

tools.name: Portable ClientHealthScoreAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Single-file BasicAgent exposes five deterministic read-only operations over bundled synthetic data with no credentials.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first runtime discovers the portable agent and provides chat, streaming, health, and browser-based review surfaces.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the five-behavior conversational package; validated pilot and manual agents remain Draft and unpublished.

tools.name: Dynamics 365
tools.detail: Approved production seam for governed account context; no live CRM connection, record creation, or mutation is enabled.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams
tools.detail: Approved internal collaboration seam for account-team review; the package sends no messages, tasks, or client outreach.

tools.name: Outlook
tools.detail: Approved seam for reviewed executive engagement; no email, calendar event, invitation, or customer contact is created.

tools.name: Deployment-selected foundation model
tools.detail: The deployment environment supplies the model used for natural-language routing and evidence-grounded response composition.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic-only evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Forbids browsing, live retrieval, enrichment, substitution, or invention beyond the two packaged knowledge sources.

supporting_features.name: Five deterministic operations
supporting_features.detail: Routes dashboard, engagement, satisfaction, at-risk prioritization, and retention-playbook requests from persona language.

supporting_features.name: Transparent indicator labeling
supporting_features.detail: Treats health scores and churn probabilities as deterministic scenario indicators, not validated predictions or certainty.

supporting_features.name: Account-team review and approval gates
supporting_features.detail: Requires account-owner review and relevant executive-sponsor, delivery, client-success, legal, and commercial approval.

supporting_features.name: No customer contact or CRM mutation
supporting_features.detail: Prohibits meetings, messages, concessions, renewal changes, outreach, CRM writes, tasks, ownership changes, and commitments.

supporting_features.name: Locked five-case validation
supporting_features.detail: All five persona-language cases passed strict Brainstem isolation, manual Preview, and Copilot Studio Draft validation.

supporting_features.name: Draft and publication control
supporting_features.detail: Keeps validated Copilot Studio agents unpublished and makes publication a distinct, explicitly confirmed administrator action.
